mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 69 degrees with overcast skies near Verona City Hall, and we have a beautiful waning crescent moon overhead.
The Verona Fire Department invites everyone to their station at 101 Lincoln Street on September 19 from 10 am to 2 pm for tours, safety activities, food, and giveaways.

It is a busy day in Verona with live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, and trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
Regarding a weekly police report, an investigation into an incident from Sunday, August 30, has led to the arrest of a 34-year-old Madison resident for the sexual assault of a child.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and you can visit the restaurant when they open today at 10:00 AM.
